results.description:
Get the world's most comprehensive ad-free dictionary and thesaurus with extensive offline dictionary content and synonyms. Dictionary Pro is the premium version of The Free Dictionary app, featuring:

* No ads.
* A comprehensive English offline dictionary and offline thesaurus. 
* Offline dictionaries in 13 other languages. 
* Offline translations of English into more than 40 languages. 
* Dozens of other offline translation options.

Rated #1 app in the App Store in the paid reference category in 109 countries 2011–2019 (Source: http://www.appannie.com/apps/ios/app/492085918/app-ranking/#device=iphone&type=best-ranks)

Plus TheFreeDictionary's classic app content:

* Find every word you search for. Get results from trusted sources: 
Webster's Dictionary
Roget's Thesaurus
The American Heritage Dictionary

+ More than 100 dictionaries and encyclopedias from these top publishers:
McGraw-Hill
Houghton Mifflin
HarperCollins
Random House
Elsevier
+ More!

* Learn the word. Clear definitions, example sentences, etymologies, illustrations, and more.

* Learn how to say it. Play audio pronunciations and hear it pronounced. 

* Learn something new. Word of the Day and other fresh daily content. 

* Find the perfect synonym fast. East-to-use Thesaurus with synonyms, antonyms, and related words.

* Explore topics in-depth. Multiple specialty dictionaries and encyclopedias: 
Medical
Legal
Science
Financial
Idioms
Acronyms and Abbreviations
+ More!

* Watch idioms in action. View idioms videos inside the app and see idioms and slang explained.

* Play word games. Spelling Bee, Hangman, and more.

* Access dictionaries in 13 other languages, including:
Spanish
French
German
Italian
Portuguese
Russian
Chinese
+ More!

What makes Dictionary Pro the most user-friendly dictionary app?
 
* Instantly look up words in apps or webpages! Just highlight the word you want to look up, tap "Share," then tap "More" in the bottom menu and turn on the "Define" option. You will then see a "Define" icon in the menu. Tap it to see the definition of the highlighted word!
* Voice search. Just say the word to look it up. 
* Advanced Search options. 
* Look up the definition of any word on the page. Just highlight and tap "Definition."
* Save bookmarks with one tap and sync them to all your devices.
* Customize your homepage: Move, add, or remove articles, games, even local weather. 
* Jump to Definition, Thesaurus, or Translations with one button. 
* Navigate the app in more than a dozen languages with the multilingual interface.
* Adjust font size. 
* Share your favorite definitions and articles via social networks, email, or text. 

EXCLUSIVE
* Earn meals for hungry children through The Free Dictionary's partnership with the World Food Program—just by using the app! 

Not convinced? 

Read our reviews to see why our users say this is the best dictionary app they've ever used. 

How do we do it?

Farlex is a leader in dictionary apps. We work with the best publishers to bring together trusted content in the most comprehensive, authoritative dictionary apps on the market. Find our other apps by searching "Dictionary by Farlex" in the App Store.

* For app developers: The Free Dictionary app can be accessed by other apps with API calls (Contact Farlex for instructions).
